import sys,struct; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
from probe import *
lib=build()
def case(**kw):
    c=dict(primitive='allreduce',mode=3,root=0,segments=4,words=1,capacity=8,start=1000,events=[],trace=0)
    c.update(kw); return c
def D(r,p,v): return {'op':'data','rank':r,'p':p,'values':v}

def decode(hexs):
    f=bytes.fromhex(hexs)
    apsn=struct.unpack('!I',f[48:52])[0]
    psn=apsn&0xffffff
    op=f[42]
    payload=f[54:len(f)-4]
    return op,psn,payload

print("== allgather K=2: destination d receives 3 records per input p ==")
evs=[D(r,p,[100*r+p]) for p in range(2) for r in range(4)]
res=run(case(events=evs,primitive='allgather',segments=2,trace=40),lib)
for t in res['trace']:
    op,psn,pl=decode(t['hex'])
    if op==4:
        print('  DATA rank=%d psn=%d (q=%d) payload=%s'%(t['rank'],psn,(psn-1000)%(1<<24),pl.hex()))
print("== reducescatter K=4 ==")
evs=[D(r,p,[100*r+p]) for p in range(4) for r in range(4)]
res=run(case(events=evs,primitive='reducescatter',segments=4,trace=60),lib)
for t in res['trace']:
    op,psn,pl=decode(t['hex'])
    if op==4:
        print('  DATA rank=%d psn=%d (q=%d) payload=%s'%(t['rank'],psn,(psn-1000)%(1<<24),pl.hex()))
EOF
